summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the advanced-packaging/HBM-backend capacity node with a two-lane bias toward underfollowed second-order suppliers rather than HBM producers. The strongest US-listed direct OSAT candidate is Amkor; the cleaner underfollowed equipment and test-tool lane includes Kulicke & Soffa, Onto Innovation, and FormFactor. Key chokepoint logic remains a hypothesis: AI/HBM demand may crowd out conventional memory backend and advanced package/test capacity, raising utilization or tool demand for qualified OSATs and packaging/test equipment vendors.
